items.question: Can I try it for free?
items.answer: Guests can explore the complete real interactive example. New accounts receive 3 one-time credits after email verification. Buy more when needed; your generated images remain available to view and save.

items.question: What is a credit?
items.answer: Generate one 1K design for 1 credit. A single 1K / 2K / 4K try-on costs 1 / 2 / 3 credits. Uploading, saving, reusing and positioning are free. Packs do not promise a fixed image count.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: No. Credits never expire. Buy now and use them whenever you want.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards through our secure payment partner, Waffo.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: If generation fails, the credits consumed for that operation are returned once. Support reviews purchase refund eligibility under the applicable terms. After a completed full refund, only that order’s remaining unused credits are recovered; spent credits, gifts and other orders’ balances are not deducted. Partial refunds require manual handling. Contact support@tattoovis.ink.
